objective: Qualify a higher-complexity temporal-authority probe without forcing a method difference or leaking answer labels
source: new synthetic signed-policy event stream, deterministic initial state, two revisions, scoped exceptions, revocation, effective-time history, untrusted note
task_design: as-of-time audit queries; all source events visible to all arms; case order permuted by fixed independent development seed; 18 cases per episode; raw prompts never contain labels or probe categories
call_calculation: 2 episodes x (18 queries x 3 paid arms + 4 compactions) = 116
prespecified_reporting: all actions and provider IDs, including invalid responses
per-arm correct/invalid counts by source-designed scenario type
per-arm prompt input tokens and compactor usage
natural outcome: may remain at ceiling
success_criteria: 108 real decisions + 8 real compactions archived, all input source hashes consistent; zero label leakage; full prespecified counts independently reproduced offline; report no causal effects
failure_policy: fail closed if oracle inconsistency, undeclared source divergence, missing model outputs, any future/holdout case or if action labels appear in prompts
qualification: Instrument technically qualified if tests, full-run and independent replay pass; empirically discriminative only if unscripted non-ceiling observations occur; otherwise status INSTRUMENT_STILL_CEILING
assumptions: same source access != same representation or equal context budget; synthetic oracle != independent real-world policy judgement
